title: A Father's Advice Once Again
content:
As the airplane finally landed...

Siddu stepped out onto the familiar soil of Bangalore.

Even though he had returned to India...

His heart was still somewhere else.

Somewhere near an airport...

Where a girl had looked into his eyes and confessed her love.

Meanwhile...

Sneha returned to her hotel in silence.

She slowly packed her luggage before leaving for Delhi.

For the first time...

The journey back felt lonely.

She sat beside the window of the taxi, staring outside.

Her thoughts never left Siddu.

First...

Distance had separated them through different cities.

Then...

Different states.

And now...

Different countries.

Soon...

Thousands of kilometers would stand between them.

A quiet determination slowly formed inside her heart.

"No matter what..."

"One day..."

"I'll meet him again."

"No matter how far you go..."

"I'll find my way to you."

________________________________________

By evening...

Siddu reached his home.

The moment he entered, his parents welcomed him with warm smiles.

For the next few hours, he spent every possible moment with them.

During dinner, he smiled and said,

"Mom... Dad..."

"Once I leave for France, I may not be able to call every day."

"So please don't worry if I miss a few calls."

"I'll take good care of myself."

"And every month, I'll send money home."

His mother smiled proudly.

His father smiled too...

But something about Siddu's smile felt different.

It looked forced.

Later that night...

His father quietly called him outside.

The two of them sat together on the veranda.

After a long silence, his father finally asked,

"Siddu..."

"What happened?"

Siddu tried to smile.

"Nothing, Dad."

His father chuckled softly.

"You've forgotten one thing."

"I'm your father."

"You can hide your words..."

"But you can't hide your heart."

Those words broke Siddu's silence.

Slowly...

He told his father everything.

About Sneha...

Their journey to Jammu...

Her care...

Her confession at the airport...

And the confusion that now filled his heart.

After listening patiently, his father smiled gently.

"So..."

"What do you want to do now?"

Siddu lowered his head.

"I don't know, Dad."

"I'm completely confused."

His father remained silent for a moment.

Then he spoke.

"Siddu..."

"Do you remember the pain you felt when someone ignored your love?"

Siddu slowly nodded.

His father placed a hand on his shoulder.

"Then don't make someone else experience that same pain."

"If your answer is yes..."

"Tell her."

"If your answer is no..."

"Tell her that too."

"But never leave a sincere heart waiting in silence."

"Whatever is in your heart..."

"Say it."

Those simple words cleared the confusion inside Siddu's mind.

A faint smile appeared on his face.

He immediately picked up his phone.

His fingers trembled slightly as he dialled Sneha's number.

On the other side...

Sneha was just about to leave for Delhi.

Her phone suddenly rang.

She looked at the screen.

"Siddu Calling..."

For a moment...

Her heart stopped.

With trembling fingers, she answered the call.

"Hello...?"

Siddu remained silent for a second.

His voice, when it finally came, was low...

Gentle...

And unusually serious.

Hearing the unusual seriousness in his voice...

Sneha's heartbeat quickened.

Something told her...

The next few words were about to change both of their lives forever.
